title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-amelia-ross-2026-03-06
body:
Daily goals
- Calls: 60 dials (aim 15 connected)
- Emails: 45 personalized follow-ups
- Book 3 discovery calls / 1 demo
- Update CRM (notes + next step) for all touched accounts
- Push 2 opportunities to 'demo scheduled'

Morning plan (9:00 - 11:30)
- 9:00 quick triage: prioritize follow-ups from yesterday (see list below)
- 9:15 cadence emails (fast personalization - mention product fit/benchmark)
- 10:00 outbound dialing block (no Slack)
- 11:00 quick sync with Liam (15m) to align on AE handoffs

Priority follow-ups (warm) - aim to call first
1) VantaCloud (CTO: Priya Nair) - last touch 2026-03-04, left voicemail.
   - Note: interested in cost comparison vs current provider, concerned about latency spikes on 99th pct.
   - Next step: call + ask to schedule 30m demo w/ Josh (AE) - target this morning.
2) OptiRetail (Dir Eng: Marco Gutierrez) - replied to email, asked for throughput metrics.
   - Note: send benchmark summary + ask about peak seq len and QPS.
   - Next step: email w/ attachments (benchmark PDF) + propose Tue/Thu demo windows.
3) Silverline Health (Head of AI: Dr. Elena Park) - warm lead from webinar.
   - Note: regulatory question re: Private deployment and KMS integration.
   - Next step: loop in Solutions Eng (Maya) and propose private deployment briefing.
4) ClearForms (VP Product: Aaron Voss) - demo requested but AE assigned hasn't confirmed schedule.
   - Note: time zone PST.
   - Next step: follow-up to confirm time + prep notes for demo around reranking use-case.

Outbound cold list (priority order) - quick script in notes
- FinOps startups x6 (target CFO/CTO) - focus on cost-saving angle (batching + quantization)
- Mid-market ecom x4 - mention embeddings + search rerank + latency SLOs
- LegalTech lead (repeat outreach) - highlight Private deployment + audit logs

Quick scripts / snippets
- Voicemail: "Hi <Name>, this is Amelia Ross from Redwood Inference. We help engineering teams cut inference costs and stabilize latency at scale. I'd love to share a short benchmark that compares typical per-token costs — can I grab 10 minutes next week? My number is 415-555-01xx. Thanks!"
- Email opener (warm): "Thanks for the note, <Name> — quick follow-up with the benchmark PDF and a few Qs on your peak seq length. If it helps, Josh (our AE) can run a 20m demo and show how batching/quantization could reduce unit cost by ~30%."

Opportunities tracker (quick)
- RWD-203 (VantaCloud) - Stage: Demo requested - Value: $120k ARR (est) - Owner: Josh - Notes: technical deep-dive needed on 99th pct latency - Action: call this morning
- RWD-198 (OptiRetail) - Stage: Discovery - Value: $45k ARR - Owner: Amelia - Notes: needs throughput numbers, send benchmark - Action: send PDF + ask for times
- RWD-210 (Silverline Health) - Stage: Qualifying - Value: $200k ARR - Owner: Amelia/Maya - Notes: compliance + KMS - Action: schedule technical briefing

Admin / blockers
- CRM: still shows duplicate contact for Marco Gutierrez — need to merge before updating activity.
- Benchmark PDF outdated — pinged Research (ticket LINEAR S-4309) for latest numbers.
- Demo environment: confirm DS credentials for VantaCloud trial (waiting on security approval).

Afternoon plan (13:30 - 17:30)
- 13:30 follow-up email push + LinkedIn connects (short notes)
- 14:30 demo prep w/ Josh (if VantaCloud confirmed) or additional dialing block
- 16:00 update CRM + log calls + next-step tags
- 16:45 end-of-day wrap: quick notes for tomorrow (what to prioritize)

Notes to self / reminders
- Keep discovery calls <30m, focus on 2-3 technical KPI questions: peak QPS, seq length distribution, current 99th pct latency and unit cost.
- Use benchmark one-pager instead of full deck when prospect is early stage.
- If prospect is compliance-heavy (health/finance), immediately offer Private deployment + KMS flow and schedule Solutions Eng.

Tomorrow high-level plan (2026-03-07)
- Follow-up on VantaCloud + OptiRetail outcomes
- 1st pass at outreach to 10 target FinOps accounts
- Prep materials for webinar follow-ups (Silverline Health + other attendees)

Misc scratch items (notes i don't want to lose)
- Hubspot filter: create view 'AMELIA - hot follow-ups' (priority: demo requested, replied last 72h)
- Ask Ops for updated GPU capacity metrics to include in outbound one-pager
- Remember to log time spent on Solutions Eng calls for internal utilization tracking

End.
